LESSON: THE BIBLE BIBLE

Grade: PP2
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: HOLY
Topic 2.1: The Bible BIBLE

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on The Bible BIBLE. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.
